answer:
To run the Ollama container with access to all NVIDIA GPUs, use the `--gpus=all` flag:

```bash
docker run -d --gpus=all -v ollama:/root/.ollama -p 11434:11434 --name ollama ollama/ollama
```

This requires the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on Linux, or Docker Desktop with the WSL2 backend and up-to-date NVIDIA drivers on Windows. To confirm the GPUs are visible inside the container, run `docker exec -it ollama nvidia-smi`.

I don't have any details about your specific project, though. I haven't inspected the files in your working directory, so if you already have a `docker-compose.yml` or other setup, share it and I can tailor the answer to it.
